name: macpro71-no-oclp-patchsets
comment: The macpro71 target (pipeline/targets/macpro71.json): MacPro7,1 natively supported by Tahoe, with a Polaris GPU Tahoe drives itself, so no OCLP root patch sets. An explicit empty patchset_order, not a missing profile: patches.py refuses a target without its profile.
